notes: new FixedThreadPool(4, workerFile) with its defaults; pool.execute({ seed, rounds }) per input, Promise.all, then await pool.destroy(). Node and Bun only: on Deno its worker_threads pool never starts (the top-level await never resolves); Deno is covered by @poolifier/poolifier-web-worker.
